description: This file contains the implementation of the SugarRest class, which provides the foundational REST protocol functionality for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It defines methods for serving requests, generating responses, and handling errors related to the REST API.

classes.name: SugarRest
classes.description: A base class implementing REST protocol for SuiteCRM, responsible for handling API requests, responses, and error management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SugarRest class with a specified implementation class.

methods.name: generateResponse
methods.description: Outputs the input array as a JSON-encoded response.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Handles incoming REST requests by invoking specified methods on the implementation class, or displaying WSDL info or errors.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Sends an error response with fault details to the client.

methods.name: generateFaultResponse
methods.description: Outputs a fault response with error details, setting appropriate HTTP headers.
